audit_meta.title: A-Stock-Sim V3 Benchmark Confusion Audit Report

root_cause_analysis.confusion_description: Legacy unified benchmark used sz000905 (厦门港务) and sz000852 (*ST中基) as CSI 500 and CSI 1000 indices.
consequences: 1. sz000905 is an active stock, leading to hash mismatch in test_unified_benchmark upon daily updates.
2. MA120 trend conditions diverged between stock and real index on 233 days (CSI 500) and 208 days (CSI 1000).
3. In V3, false breakout of single stocks triggered structural rotation mode inappropriately.
